name: unauthorized-delta-empty-approved-scope
description: A valid change set whose semantic delta no approved scope covers. `approved_scope` is present and empty — an explicit statement that nothing is approved, which is not the same as omitting the field.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model in a scoped session where the user has approved nothing. The change set removes a component and clears the connector that refers to it — internally consistent, and outside every approved address.

authorization.notes: Empty by intent. No protocol operation can approve anything: approval stays a host-side human interaction.

input.intent: Remove the consumer component and its connector.

expected.notes: The decision is made on the delta — operation plus address — and never on a tool name, which is why the rejection can name both uncovered addresses. There is no partial approval: a scope covering one of the two removes still refuses the change set, because the commit boundary applies the reviewed delta whole or not at all. The real model stays byte-identical.
